name: ccMixter
summary: Creative Commons music, samples and a cappellas from the ccMixter community, through its Query API: search uploads by tags, user, license, remixes and dates.
notes: Free and keyless. Every call is a GET to /api/query; the parameters decide which records, how many and in what format.
Always pass f (format): the default is a full HTML page. Use f=json for data; xml, rss, atom, csv and count are also available.
limit cannot exceed the site's admin-set maximum for the format (typically 100-200 for json/csv); page through with offset.
Each upload carries its own Creative Commons license (lic): check it before reuse.

endpoints.name: Search uploads
endpoints.summary: Uploads (tracks, samples, a cappellas) filtered by tags, uploader, license, text, remix counts, playlist or dates.

tags.description: Tags separated by '+'; with several tags set type to all or any.

type.description: For uploads: all or any, how multiple tags combine.

u.description: Only uploads by this user (login name).

search.description: Text words or phrase to search for.

search_type.description: match for an exact phrase, any or all of the terms.

lic.description: License: by Attribution, nc NonCommercial, sa Share-Alike, nod NoDerives, byncsa, byncnd, s Sampling, splus Sampling+, ncsplus, pd Public Domain.

remixesof.description: Remixes of this user's uploads (login name).

remixmin.description: Uploads remixed at least this many times.

remixmax.description: Uploads remixed at most this many times.

score.description: Uploads with at least this many ratings.

playlist.description: Records in this numeric playlist id.

sinced.description: Since a date string, e.g. '3 weeks ago' or 'July 2006'.

sort.description: Sort field, e.g. name, fullname, last_edit, num_scores.

dataview.description: Columns to return for non-HTML formats, e.g. info for deep upload details, links, files, ids.

limit.description: At most this many records (capped by the site).

offset.description: Records to skip, with limit, for paging.

notes: f=count returns only the number of matching uploads.
